title: Day close
description: End each business day per branch with numbers you can trust: what was sold, collected and spent, where the cash is, and anything that does not add up.

list.title: Recent days
list.empty: No days with activity in this period
list.emptyHint: Days appear here once something is sold, paid or moved.

view.drift: The stored numbers of this day no longer match its ledgers. Something was changed after the close: check it with your system administrator.
view.lastCloseHint: This day was closed and then reopened. Below: the numbers as they were at the last close.
view.blocked: Fix the problems marked as blocking before closing the day.

fields.totalClosingCash: Cash in the branch at the end of the day
fields.shopWide: Shop-wide bank: this branch's movements only
fields.noEta: This shop does not send e-receipts.

issues.title: Problems and notes
issues.none: Everything adds up. Nothing to fix.
issues.SHIFT_OPEN: Shift {number} of {cashier} is still open. It has to be closed before the day.
issues.LEDGER_MISMATCH: The stored balance of {name} is {cached}, but its ledger adds up to {fromLedger}.
issues.DOCUMENT_WITHOUT_LEDGER: The {document} {number} says {documentAmount}, but the cash ledger has {ledgerAmount}.
issues.DOCUMENT_WITHOUT_LEDGER_missing: A cash movement of {ledgerAmount} has no {document} behind it.
issues.DOCUMENT_WITHOUT_LEDGER_more: And {count} more documents that don't match.
issues.ETA_NOT_ACCEPTED: ETA has accepted {accepted} of the day's {total} receipts. The rest are waiting or need a fix.
issues.DAY_DRIFT: The stored numbers of this closed day no longer match its ledgers.
issues.SHIFT_DIFFERENCE: Shift {number} of {cashier} closed with a difference of {difference}: {reason}
issues.EARLIER_DAY_OPEN: {count} earlier days with activity are not closed yet (the first is {date}).

close.title: Close the day
close.description: The numbers are stored as they are now. After this, nothing can be posted on this day in this branch unless the owner reopens it.
close.today: This is today: once it is closed, no more sales, payments or expenses can be posted today in this branch.
close.warnings: The day has {count} warnings. Say why you are closing it anyway.
close.noteRequired: Write a note of at least 3 characters.
close.changed: Something was posted after you opened this day. The numbers are updated: check them and close again.

reopen.title: Reopen the day
reopen.description: The day takes entries again until it is closed again. The reason is kept in the audit log.
reopen.reasonRequired: Write a reason of 3 to 500 characters.

errors.notFound: This day close was not found.
errors.branchDenied: You don't work in this branch.
errors.future: A day in the future can't be closed.
errors.changed: Something was posted after you opened this day. Check the new numbers and close again.
errors.blocked: Fix the blocking problems before closing the day.
errors.noteRequired: The day has warnings: write a note.
errors.reason: Write a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
errors.validation: Check the form and try again.

card.title: Day close
card.description: Days not closed yet and what the night check found.
card.critical: {count} balances or documents don't add up
